notes.title: 🦉Hotfix done diddly delivered
notes.notes:
[b]Sorry for those who experienced inverted controls there has been a quick fix added that should stop it until the look script is redone to avoid this logic glitch.[/b]

Huge thanks to the community for reporting these glitches (all these fixes are from you guys!). ːsteamhappyː

[list]
[*] Player inverting controls when you lag around the camera clamp
[*] level 4 eating your cubes
[*] Not being able to pickup a cube in one of the levels after putting it down
[*] level progression removed due to repeated bugs and complaints  
[/list]
[u]p.s all levels should now be unlocked[/u]

notes.title: Im a Jew
notes.notes:
[h1]Due to the Jewish sabbatical during Saturdays I wasn't able to receive any bug reports and push needed updates sorry bout that! [/h1]

[b]What I'm working on fixing right now...[/b]

[list]
[*] Levels sometimes relocking themselves after you have solved them 
[*] Controls inverting (actually its the camera being rotated 180 degrees :c)
[*] Level 4 eating your cubes (easy fix)
[*] Not being able to pickup a cube in one of the levels (easy fix) 
[/list]

If you look up and turn the camera will glitch and rotate 180 degrees, you can temporarily fix this by looking up again and turning around until I push an update fixing it. Sorry!

notes.title: 🔥Duality Release Update 🔥
notes.notes:
[h1]🕎Happy Hanukkah and Merry Christmas!🎄[/h1]

[b]Got some last minute changes and fixes pushed for release tomorrow and for all early access special people suffering at the hands of spaghetti code! Sorry for the hour delay on release, my internet sucks[/b]
[list]
[*] Entire new physics system for the player now non-framerate dependent!
[*] Iffy physics calculations with cubes going through walls + glitching fixed!
[*] Notable changes on level 1 with tutorial extension for dummies 
[*] Fixed glass overlap in level 3
[*] (new music coming soon i swear) music tracks switched around
[*] Cube no longer rotates when picked up: (feedback? <3) 
[*] Th_Pion's unknowingly discovered bug we don't talk about is fixed.
[*] Feedback from playtesters has been implemented with the player script
[*] Platforms rotating you 90 degrees unconsensually fixed!
[*] Weird flying jump bug has been squashed 
[*] Level 3 funky drop cube thingy now un-funkified

[*] Tweaks to lvl 3 and pushing the dimensional slider thing to be less clunky

[*] Fixed all the dim platforms too sloped for the new physics 
[*] Subscribe to pewdiepie 
[*] Did a bunch of tweaks to elevators around the globe now easier to use
[*] Removed extra cubes laying around hiding from me 
[*] Disabled cubes now have handicap elevators (progressive eh?)
[*] I only got 2 hours of sleep please love me
[*] Increased physics timestep recursion (fancy words) for cubes (is better)
[*] Added checkpoints to lots of areas (will add more later after sleep)

[/list]

[b]If you got any level ideas, bug reports, questions etc come join the discord :p [/b]

notes.title: 3 days from release! My stuff and things because reasons.
notes.notes:
Finals week is over and youtubers/streamers are starting to receive early access keys etc and all those nasty bugs 3 waves of beta testers couldn't find are coming to haunt me. 

Why am I reprogramming the player days before the release? Don't worry about it that's why, because it will totally be done by friday. (Who needs sleep anyway)

Now that I have all this free time expect regular updates and bigfixes with more content after duality's release. Don't think that just because it isn't in early access I won't be working on it after it comes out. 

Pretty hyped about my first game coming out and hope you guys have fun playing it! ːsteamhappyː
